name: UBTECH Walker Tienkung Voice & Vision
summary: The 21-DOF entry version of the Walker Tienkung research humanoid for walking, speech and vision work; its hands do not grip. Orderable from RobotShop Europe as Walker E Lite.

priceEur.note: RobotShop Europe price shown with VAT for Germany; includes wireless controller and 200 W power adapter.

germany.leadTime: RobotShop: on-demand item, ordered from the supplier; due date shown at checkout

sellers.name: RobotShop Europe (RobotShop inc., eu.robotshop.com)
sellers.note: Listed as Walker E Voice & Vision, manufacturer no. Walker E Lite; on-demand item with add-to-cart and quote request.

sellers.name: Terra Robotics (Terra Connect GmbH)
sellers.note: Variant "Voice & Vision"; metadata price EUR 104,000, basis not stated, not displayed.

germany.statusNote: RobotShop Europe sells this robot as "Walker E Voice & Vision" (Walker E Lite, also known as Tienkung) at EUR 70,318.18 incl. VAT, on demand, with delivery to Germany; Terra Robotics quotes on request.

specs.label: DOF per arm
specs.conditions: shoulder 3, elbow 1; no wrist or hand

specs.label: Running speed
specs.conditions: up to; Terra states 10 km/h, RobotShop about 7 km/h

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Intel Core i7 + NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (275 TOPS)

specs.label: Software
specs.value: ROS 2, full motor and sensor API

notes: 4-DOF arms without wrists; RobotShop calls the hands non-functional, so it cannot pick objects and is recorded with 0 working arms.
For locomotion, speech and vision research.
